# Vanguard + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-09-22 | Duration: 43.54999923706055m

## Summary
Vanguard is seeking a centralized, self-service experimentation platform to address inconsistent tools and methods across decentralized teams, improve knowledge sharing, and support end-to-end experiment design, execution, and documentation. Laura described the applied economics and behavioral science team’s enterprise-wide role in running tests for other business units. GrowthBook presented a warehouse-native architecture that queries aggregated warehouse data, supports self-hosting, enables metric updates, and limits data movement. Its capabilities include randomization, assignment, feature flags, staged rollouts, user targeting, A/B tests, multi-armed bandits, Bayesian and frequentist analysis, power calculations, health checks, guardrails, audit logs, and collaboration tools. Templates, AI-powered hypothesis suggestions, historical experiment learnings, and visual documentation aim to help less-experienced users create stronger experiments and avoid duplicated work. Christian also outlined platform-plus-per-user pricing, while offering follow-up materials and discussions about pricing and infrastructure requirements.

## Keywords
experimentation, warehouse native, feature flagging, power calculation, AI integration, decentralized testing

## Action Items

**Christian Liebenow**
Send GrowthBook demo recording and a short five-minute demo clip to Laura for distribution to the Vanguard team, including director Guillaume (40:03)
Consider and send relevant GrowthBook documentation and materials to Laura to aid Vanguard’s evaluation (40:36)

**Laura**
Forward the demo recording and information to Vanguard’s director Guillaume and coordinate any follow-up questions from him or her to the GrowthBook team (40:17)
Communicate any additional questions from Vanguard’s side to Christian or Logan for further clarification (40:17)
